frozen: 2026-11-24, before any variant was built (the six lanes were dispatched after this file and CONTRACT.md were written)

requirements.name: The whole dataset at a glance
requirements.why: His first like (Nov 24): "at a glance being able to see like the entire trajectory dataset, and then also like the tool position and orientations".
requirements.passCondition: From the landing, joint coverage, tool position and tool orientation of all 54 trajectories are each one click (a tab) away or already on screen, readable without scrolling a tab.

anchors.1: The dataset view is lost or buried behind per-trajectory navigation.
anchors.3: Every aspect is reachable, but a figure needs scrolling or reads poorly at 1440 × 900.
anchors.5: Each aspect fills one calm screen; the landing alone says what the dataset covers.

requirements.name: From the dataset to one trajectory, and into Rerun
requirements.why: "There is no drill in option in the trajectories page … I want the option to open in Rerun".
requirements.passCondition: One action on a trajectory shows its own numbers and motion, and one more opens it in Rerun; getting back keeps the dataset context.

anchors.1: No drill, or Rerun needs a command typed by hand.
anchors.3: A drill exists but shows little beyond the row, or loses the dataset context.
anchors.5: The drill shows the trajectory's motion and what it adds to the dataset, Rerun is one click, back is one click.

requirements.name: Find and keep slices of the dataset
requirements.why: "I should also be able to like filter etc this table, and possibly like create saved views".
requirements.passCondition: Filter, sort, group and save the current view, and come back to it.

anchors.3: Filter and sort, saved views fixed or session-only.
anchors.5: Text + column filters, group with fold, sort, and user-saved views that persist.

requirements.name: Controls appear where they apply; colours set once
requirements.why: "I don't like how these settings always show … the joint selector should just apply on the single joint view and the colors … in a settings gear in the top right corner".
requirements.passCondition: No control is on screen where it does nothing; global colour settings sit behind one gear and apply everywhere.

anchors.1: A control strip shows everywhere regardless of the view.
anchors.3: Mostly scoped, with a stray control or settings in two places.
anchors.5: Every visible control acts on what is in view; the gear holds the global ones and they apply everywhere.

requirements.name: Common visual language (data-ui)
requirements.why: "the nice thing with data-ui is its the common visual language"; "it should be one of our like generic tables from data-ui"; "In some sense this is really just a dashboard on data right…?".
requirements.passCondition: The page is built from data-ui's parts, and what it adds can become stock data-ui parts other apps reuse.

anchors.1: Fully bespoke; nothing shared with his other apps.
anchors.3: Looks like data-ui or uses its table, but the coverage figures stay bespoke to this page.
anchors.5: Built from data-ui parts, and the coverage figures become stock data-ui views any app can use.

requirements.name: Every colour and mark explained
requirements.why: "The trajectories have these random colors next to them but its not clear what those mean"; Nov 23: "good as long as you show the legend of the meaning of the lines".
requirements.passCondition: Every colour, line and mark on screen has a legend or label nearby.

anchors.3: Main figures have legends; some marks (row chips, highlights) do not.
anchors.5: Everything coloured is keyed where it is shown.

hardGates.name: Headline numbers on the overview only
Table filters, sorts, saves views; a row drills in and opens in Rerun
hardGates.why: Feedback 2 and 4, measured by check.cjs (G2, G2b).

hardGates.name: Joint picker scoped; colours behind one gear and repainting
Runs clean on the shared UR5e data at 1440 × 900
hardGates.why: No console errors, no sideways scroll, numbers from analyze (check.cjs G5, G6; CONTRACT.md).
